coverage_states.RAW_PRESERVED: Captured values/HTML/attributes available for offline reprocessing.
coverage_states.PARSER_MISSING: Raw evidence present but no parser extraction is implemented.
coverage_states.FILTER_PENDING: Known filter/variant not verified or reconciled.
coverage_states.CAPTURE_PENDING: No valid base snapshot for the resource/scope.
coverage_states.ACCESS_BLOCKED: A current controlled request returned challenge/block.
coverage_states.SOURCE_ABSENT: Absence proven only within an explicitly named sampled page/table.
coverage_states.UNKNOWN: Evidence does not distinguish presence from absence.
